status: Initial workflow definition from engineer; not a general implemented modelling engine
additional_views: As needed to describe actual structure
sheet_policy: Combine views when size and legibility allow; otherwise additional sheets
model_scale: 1:1 actual units when geometry is established

rules.rule: Separate bespoke-item workflow covers chimneys, tripods, buildings, water towers and other site structures.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Photos and written dimensioned sketches define the item; supplementary GA/details are optional evidence.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Supplied example images guide presentation, not new-item geometry, dimensions or specifications.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Use written measurements and actual-unit model coordinates, normally mm; do not infer dimensions by scaling photos/PDFs.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Link features/dimensions to source regions, photo directions and exact engineer answers.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Identify faces, edges, centrelines and levels; external/internal datum determines dimension extension origins.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Keep measured, confirmed, derived, estimated and unknown information distinct in geometry and drawings.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Build one coherent dimension-controlled geometry model; all 2D views and the 3D render derive from it.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Minimum outputs are plan and elevation; add orthogonal elevations, different-level plans or sections when necessary.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Do not invent hidden construction, symmetry, tapers, reinforcement, connections or member specifications.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Use black CAD dimensions/text, clear extensions, line weights and appropriate hatching; show supplied specifications.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Technical 3D view uses clean background, clear edges and restrained material appearance; geometry must match 2D.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Use labelled sections/cutaways to explain internal geometry when appropriate; distinguish from physical openings.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Combine 2D and 3D views on one sheet when legible; use extra sheets when size/detail requires.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Reuse KA sheet branding and current project metadata, but use an item-specific title/identifier.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Inspect first, batch precise unresolved questions, retain answers and update dependent geometry once.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Check dimension closure, datums, levels, cross-view consistency, readability and actual exported files.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Deliver PDF and DWG drawings, an editable 3D geometry model and matching rendered view. Choose and validate the model format for the item/software.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Distinguish true-size model geometry from scaled sheet views and NTS sheet-space CAD; label actual export space.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions

rules.rule: Reuse one model and sheet tools; batch exports; clear scoped superseded deliverables when requested, retaining evidence.
rules.authority: Engineer bespoke-item instruction; shared KA drawing/interpretation conventions
